ls -la /data /data/source_a /data/source_b /data/source_c /app 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '--- source_a ---'
sed -n '1,80p' /data/source_a/users.json 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '--- source_b ---'
sed -n '1,80p' /data/source_b/users.csv 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '--- python/libs ---'
python3 - <<'PY'
mods = ['pandas','pyarrow','fastparquet','numpy']
for m in mods:

        mod = __import__(m)

    except Exception as e:
        print(m, 'MISSING', e)

print(t.schema)
df=t.to_pandas()
print('DTYPES')
print(df.dtypes)
print('ROWS')
print(df.to_string(index=False))
